title: Same Book, Different Fills: Partial Identification of FIFO Execution from Aggregate Order Books
abstract: arXiv:2609.13597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Price-level limit order book (L2) data reveal aggregate liquidity but not the ordered queue required by price--time priority. Passive-execution backtests can therefore depend on an unobserved cancellation-allocation rule even when observed prices, quantities, and trades are held fixed. We frame recovery of market-by-order histories from aggregate snapshots as a conditional partial identification problem: multiple histories can reproduce the same aggregate path. Holding that path, reconciled market removals, latent order partitions, and additions fixed, our path-preserving compiler varies only cancellation allocation among front, quantity-weighted-random, and back rules. Within this compiler class, we establish front--back fill ordering for a virtual tagged order during one touch-price spell. We study seven months of synchronized 2025 Tokyo Stock Exchange data for two instruments with different trading activity: RIC 1301.T and RIC 7911.T.

translated_title: 同一订单簿，不同成交：从聚合订单簿对FIFO执行的部分识别
translated_abstract: 价格档位限价订单簿（L2）数据揭示了聚合流动性，但无法提供价格-时间优先原则所需的有序队列信息。因此，即使在观察到的价格、数量和交易保持不变的情况下，被动执行回测的结果仍可能依赖于一个不可观察的撤单分配规则。我们将从聚合快照中恢复逐笔订单历史的问题构建为一个条件部分识别问题：多个历史记录可以重现相同的聚合路径。在固定该聚合路径、已核对的市价订单移除、潜在订单划分和新增订单的前提下，我们的路径保持编译器仅在三种撤单分配规则（前置规则、数量加权随机规则和后置规则）之间变化。在该编译器类别内，我们建立了一次触及价格区间内虚拟标记订单的前后成交排序关系。我们研究了2025年东京证券交易所七个月的同步数据，涵盖两种交易活跃度不同的证券：RIC 1301.T 和 RIC 7911.T。
tldr: 该论文将利用聚合订单簿快照恢复逐笔订单历史建模为条件部分识别问题，通过路径保持编译器证明多个不同订单历史可产生相同的聚合路径，并建立了不同撤单分配规则下虚拟标记订单的成交排序关系。
en_tdlr: This paper frames the recovery of order-by-order histories from aggregate order book snapshots as a conditional partial identification problem, using a path-preserving compiler to show that multiple histories can reproduce the same aggregate path, and establishes front-back fill ordering for virtual tagged orders across different cancellation-allocation rules.
